name: Shahril Hamdan
post: Managing Director, Watchtower Advisory; podcast co-host
background: Former UMNO information chief and PMO economic director; lost the Alor Gajah seat in 2022 and now works in advisory and media.
changed: No longer holds party or government post; left UMNO information chief role in 2022.

name: Tengku Zafrul Aziz
post: PKR political bureau (ex-officio); senior political adviser to the Prime Minister
background: Former finance and trade minister and appointed senator who left UMNO in 2025 and joined PKR; Senate term ended December 2025.
wants: A Selangor seat to contest in GE16
changed: Left UMNO in May 2025, joined PKR; no longer a senator.

name: Asyraf Wajdi Dusuki
background: Former UMNO Youth chief; reappointed MARA chairman for two years from March 2026.

name: Onn Hafiz Ghazi
background: Machap assemblyman; led BN to a large win in the July 2026 Johor election and was sworn in for a second term.

name: Saarani Mohamad
background: Perak Menteri Besar since 2020; dismissed talk of a snap state election in April 2026.

name: Muhammad Sanusi Md Nor
background: Kedah Menteri Besar since 2020; declined the PN chairmanship in January 2026 and proposed Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar instead.

name: Azmin Ali
background: Appointed Bersatu election director in May 2026; resigned his PN post effective January 2026 and ruled out returning to PKR.

name: Zuraida Kamaruddin
background: Former PKR vice-president and plantation minister who left for Bersatu then Parti Bangsa Malaysia; says she will not rejoin PKR for now.
